---
name: Skill proposal
about: Propose a new practitioner capability without expanding the catalog by default.
title: "[skill] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## What would a designer naturally say?

Give one or two ordinary-language requests that should activate this capability.

## What practitioner problem does it solve?

Describe the repeatable UX problem, not the artifact it produces.

## Why can't an existing skill handle it?

Name the closest current skill and explain the meaningful difference.

## What should it inspect first?

What project, design-system, research, accessibility, engineering, or decision context matters?

## What should good behavior look like?

Describe the useful judgment or outcome. Add a short Bad / Good / Why contrast if it clarifies the distinction.

## Guardrails

What must the skill not invent, assume, automate, or over-document?
